pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...g6, Main Line
pages.notes: The overview described a White isolated pawn when White is a pawn up after the 7...O-O gambit; plan 1 played Ne5 with no knight able to reach it; plan 3 blockaded on d5, where White's pawn stands. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3 (reviewer: plan 2 rejected once for assuming White keeps d5, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...g6, Main Line, 8.Be2
pages.notes: The overview described an isolated pawn instead of the gambit; plan 1 read e5 as a move; plan 2 blockaded on d5, where White's pawn stands. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 2 (reviewer: plan 1's knight on e5 rejected as unconfirmed, revised to Bf3 and Nge2, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence:Burris Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured Qxd3 before ...Bxd3 and missed the gambit's point, ...Qxd4. Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer: first draft called the d-file open and ignored ...Qxd4, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Gurgenidze System
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight via d7 to f8 (bishop there) or e8-f6 (king there). Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: 4.Nxe4 Nf6 5.f3 Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported an e4-pawn White doesn't have (a knight stands on e4). Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: 4.Nxe4 Nf6 5.Ng3
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the g3-knight via f1 after castling, where the rook stands; plans 1 and 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: 4.Nxe4 Nf6 5.Nxf6+
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote h2-h4-h5 as a single route; plan 2 called the e-file semi-open after ...exf6 (it is open). Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Gurgenidze: 4.e5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 with Nf3 planned in the way. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Gurgenidze: 4.e5 Bg7 5.f4 Nh6
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the knight to f7, where Black's pawn stands; plan 1 wrote the bishop squares as Be2/d3. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (reviewer: a claim that only g2-g4 can challenge f5 rejected, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Gurgenidze: 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 named ...Bg7 in a way the parser could not read and offered ...e6 as a break. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.
